timezone.note: Midnight UTC maps to 10:00 AEST while local timezone remains +10.

codex.tracking_note: Use as the current baseline for 5-hour and weekly Codex capacity windows.

owl-alpha_openrouter_free.source: OpenRouter docs: API Rate Limits and FAQ
owl-alpha_openrouter_free.tracking_note: Treat 10:00 AEST as the expected reset time, then measure real Owl Alpha usable capacity by recording exhaustion-to-exhaustion baselines.

tracking_rule: Use exhaustion baselines: record when a cloud model runs out, then compare with the next exhaustion point after reset to estimate usable capacity.
sb_policy_link: During run SB, do not spend Owl Alpha/Codex except explicit expiry/capacity checkpoints. Run cloud review only after the local batch completion gate.
